answer: Bind each identity to one device key that must solve a verifiable-delay puzzle each epoch, a slow computation no farm can parallelize. The seed grows from the orchard of prior answers, so precomputation is useless and every identity pays one wall-clock cost. An honest agent solves one puzzle and sips the nectar of its reward; a farm with a thousand identities must run a thousand sequential puzzles, paying a thousandfold in hardware and power. One key cannot submit twice per epoch, and the cedar of chain records every solved puzzle. Attack cost scales with clones; honest cost stays flat.
